title: Secure Archival - HoD Rejection Workflow (End-to-End)
description: Verify the complete end-to-end basis workflow BW-BA-01 / composite CW-BA-01 Path 1 where a user submits a valid secure archival request and the respective departmental HoD rejects it.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated and belongs to Department CS. Department CS HoD is active. User has sufficient archival quota.

test_inputs.rejection_reason: Insufficient justification for department archival storage

execution_steps: Step 1: User submits secure archival request with valid file metadata and initial classification via BA-UC-002.
Step 2: System validates request parameters and quota, transitions state from Not Submitted to Submitted, and routes request to CS HoD.
Step 3: CS HoD reviews request details and submits decision Outcome = Reject via BA-UC-003.
Step 4: System updates archival request state from Submitted to Rejected and records decision notification.
expected_outcome: Request state transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> Rejected. Decision recorded and requester receives rejection notification. Request does not proceed to SysAdmin classification.
failure_guarantee: If HoD rejection fails, request state remains Submitted and no unauthorized classification or archival is initiated.

title: Secure Archival - HoD Approval with Non-Sensitive SysAdmin Classification
description: Verify end-to-end workflow BW-BA-02 / CW-BA-01 Path 2 where a secure archival request is approved by HoD and authoritative classification assigned by SysAdmin is non-Sensitive (Routine/Critical/Archival), completing at Classified Non-Sensitive / Policy Applied.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated and has available quota. Department HoD and SysAdmin accounts are operational.
execution_steps: Step 1: User submits secure archival request via BA-UC-002.
Step 2: System validates submission, transitions request from Not Submitted to Submitted, and routes to EE HoD.
Step 3: EE HoD evaluates request and submits decision Outcome = Approve via BA-UC-003.
Step 4: System updates request state from Submitted to HoD Approved and routes request to SysAdmin queue.
Step 5: SysAdmin reviews request and assigns authoritative classification Routine (Classification != Sensitive) via BA-UC-004.
Step 6: System applies non-sensitive retention policy and transitions state to Classified Non-Sensitive / Policy Applied.
expected_outcome: Request transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> HoD Approved -> Classified Non-Sensitive / Policy Applied. Standard retention policy applied; request is NOT routed to IT Security.
failure_guarantee: If classification fails, request remains in HoD Approved state without policy application.

title: Secure Archival - HoD Approval, Sensitive Classification, and IT Security AES-256 Encryption
description: Verify complete end-to-end basis workflow BW-BA-03 / composite CW-BA-01 Path 3 through User submission, HoD approval, SysAdmin Sensitive classification, routing to IT Security, and IT Security AES-256 encryption/archive creation.
pre_conditions: User belongs to department ME. HoD, SysAdmin, and IT Security accounts are active. Storage quota available.
execution_steps: Step 1: User submits secure archival request with metadata via BA-UC-002.
Step 2: System validates request and transitions state to Submitted, routing to ME HoD.
Step 3: ME HoD approves the request via BA-UC-003; system transitions state to HoD Approved.
Step 4: SysAdmin assigns authoritative classification Sensitive via BA-UC-004.
Step 5: System transitions state to Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security and places request in IT Security queue.
Step 6: IT Security Team configures AES-256 encryption parameters and executes archive creation via BA-UC-005.
Step 7: System verifies encrypted artifact creation at rest and in transit, transitioning state to Sensitive Archive Encrypted.
expected_outcome: Request state transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> HoD Approved -> Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security -> Sensitive Archive Encrypted. AES-256 encryption applied.
failure_guarantee: If encryption configuration fails, state remains Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security; unencrypted archive is never stored.

title: Secure Archival Submission - Unsatisfied Submission Guard (Validation Failure)
description: Verify that when a user submits a secure archival request that fails parameter validation (e.g. missing required file name or exceeding quota), the submission guard fails and the system does not advance to Submitted state.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated. User storage quota is exceeded or submission payload lacks required metadata fields.
execution_steps: Step 1: User attempts to submit secure archival request missing mandatory fields (file name, owners, reason) via BA-UC-002.
Step 2: BADMS performs request data and quota validation checks.
Step 3: System detects validation failures (missing required fields / quota check failure).
expected_outcome: Validation fails with specific error messages; request state remains Not Submitted; no request is routed to HoD.
failure_guarantee: Validation failure produces errors without request-state change; database integrity is preserved.

title: Secure Archival Submission - Omitted Initial Classification Defaults to Routine
description: Verify that when initial classification is omitted by the user during archival submission, BADMS automatically assigns Routine and successfully transitions state from Not Submitted to Submitted.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated and has sufficient storage quota.
execution_steps: Step 1: User submits secure archival request with all required fields except initial_classification via BA-UC-002.
Step 2: BADMS detects omitted initial classification and applies default classification Routine.
Step 3: BADMS validates quota and request metadata.
Step 4: System creates request in Submitted state and routes to Math HoD.
expected_outcome: Request state transitions to Submitted with initial classification recorded as Routine; routed to respective HoD.
failure_guarantee: Absence of classification input never leads to undefined state; default Routine is deterministically set.

title: Secure Archival Decision - Cross-Department HoD Scope Restriction (Authorization Guard Unsatisfied)
primary_obligation: CW-BA-01 Decision Point HoD Authorization Guard
description: Verify that an HoD from a different department cannot decide an archival request, enforcing department-scope restriction and separation of duties.
pre_conditions: A secure archival request for a CS department user is in Submitted state pending HoD review.
execution_steps: Step 1: Physics HoD attempts to approve CS department archival request REQ-ARC-CS-101 via BA-UC-003.
Step 2: BADMS checks separation of duties and department-scope restriction between actor department (Physics) and request department (CS).
Step 3: BADMS blocks the unauthorized decision and logs security/access violation.
expected_outcome: Decision is rejected with Authorization/Scope error; request state remains Submitted in CS HoD queue.
failure_guarantee: HoDs act only within their department; cross-department approval transitions are strictly prohibited.

title: Secure Archival Classification - Non-SysAdmin Classification Attempt (Authorization Guard Unsatisfied)
primary_obligation: CW-BA-01 Decision Point SysAdmin Authorization Guard
description: Verify that only an authorized SysAdmin can assign authoritative archival classification; classification attempts by non-SysAdmin actors are rejected.
pre_conditions: Archival request is in HoD Approved state.
execution_steps: Step 1: Standard User (or non-SysAdmin actor) invokes BA-UC-004 to classify request REQ-ARC-CS-102.
Step 2: BADMS verifies actor role against authoritative classification permission.
Step 3: BADMS denies access and logs unauthorized classification attempt.
expected_outcome: Action rejected with 403 Forbidden / Unauthorized error; request state remains HoD Approved.
failure_guarantee: Authoritative classification authority remains solely with SysAdmin; state cannot advance without authorized SysAdmin action.

title: Secure Archival Encryption - IT Security Encryption Failure (Guard Unsatisfied)
description: Verify that when AES-256 encryption or archive creation fails during IT Security execution, the system does not transition to Sensitive Archive Encrypted and logs an error.
pre_conditions: Request is in state Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security.

test_inputs.simulated_error: Cryptographic key store unavailable / cipher generation error

execution_steps: Step 1: IT Security initiates AES-256 encryption and archive creation via BA-UC-005.
Step 2: System encounters cryptographic service failure during cipher processing.
Step 3: System catches encryption exception and aborts archive creation.
expected_outcome: Encryption failure error returned; request state remains Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security; error logged in security audit.
failure_guarantee: Unencrypted or corrupt archives are never marked as Sensitive Archive Encrypted.

title: Secure Archival Encryption - Unauthorized Encryption Configuration Attempt by SysAdmin
description: Verify separation of duties: SysAdmin cannot configure encryption for Sensitive data; only IT Security Team has authority to execute BA-UC-005.
pre_conditions: Request is in state Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security.
execution_steps: Step 1: SysAdmin attempts to configure encryption and generate sensitive archive via BA-UC-005.
Step 2: BADMS checks role-boundary separation between SysAdmin and IT Security Team.
Step 3: BADMS rejects the action due to separation of duties violation.
expected_outcome: Access denied; state remains Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security awaiting IT Security action.
failure_guarantee: Role separation is enforced; IT Security alone owns encryption configuration for sensitive archives.

title: Storage Extension - HoD Rejection Workflow (End-to-End)
description: Verify end-to-end storage-extension workflow BW-BA-04 / CW-BA-02 Path 1 where a user with full quota requests extension and departmental HoD rejects it.
pre_conditions: User storage quota is 100% full. Departmental HoD is active.

test_inputs.rejection_notes: Exceeds department allocated infrastructure threshold for current quarter

execution_steps: Step 1: User submits storage-extension request via BA-UC-007.
Step 2: System validates that current quota is full and available infrastructure is registered; transitions state from Not Submitted to Submitted and routes to Civil HoD.
Step 3: Civil HoD reviews request, available departmental infrastructure, and justification via BA-UC-008.
Step 4: HoD selects Outcome = Reject; BADMS records decision and transitions state to Rejected.
Step 5: System issues decision notification to requester.
expected_outcome: Request state transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> Rejected. Decision recorded; user quota remains at 50 GB.
failure_guarantee: If HoD rejection fails, state remains Submitted; quota is not modified.

title: Storage Extension - HoD Approval Workflow (End-to-End)
description: Verify end-to-end storage-extension workflow BW-BA-05 / CW-BA-02 Path 2 where user submits extension request upon full quota and HoD approves, terminating at recorded Approved state.
pre_conditions: User storage quota is full. Department infrastructure has capacity for requested extension.

extension_request.justification: Wind tunnel sensor high-speed telemetry logs

execution_steps: Step 1: User submits storage-extension request via BA-UC-007.
Step 2: BADMS validates usage and infrastructure availability, sets state to Submitted, and routes to Aerospace HoD.
Step 3: Aerospace HoD reviews request details, departmental policy, and justification via BA-UC-008.
Step 4: HoD selects Outcome = Approve; BADMS records approval and transitions state to Approved.
Step 5: System issues approval notification to requester; workflow ends at Approved state without additional post-approval processing.
expected_outcome: Request state transitions: Not Submitted -> Submitted -> Approved. Decision recorded; notification sent.
failure_guarantee: Workflow terminates cleanly at Approved state as required by current baseline specification.

title: Storage Extension Submission - Quota Not Full / Infrastructure Exceeded (Validation Guard Unsatisfied)
description: Verify that storage-extension request submission is rejected when user quota is not full or requested extension exceeds available infrastructure.
pre_conditions: User current storage usage is 30 GB out of 100 GB allocated quota (quota is NOT full).
execution_steps: Step 1: User attempts to submit storage-extension request via BA-UC-007 when current quota usage is only 30%.
Step 2: BADMS evaluates submission guard (storage quota full check).
Step 3: BADMS detects quota is not full and rejects submission.
expected_outcome: Submission rejected with error 'Storage extension can only be requested when current quota is full'; state remains Not Submitted.
failure_guarantee: Premature extension requests are blocked; state invariant Not Submitted is preserved.

title: Storage Extension Decision - Unauthorized Decision Attempt by SysAdmin
primary_obligation: CW-BA-02 Decision Point HoD Authorization Guard
description: Verify that only the respective HoD can approve or reject a storage-extension request; technical SysAdmin cannot approve storage-extension requests.
pre_conditions: Storage-extension request is in Submitted state awaiting HoD decision.
execution_steps: Step 1: SysAdmin attempts to submit decision for storage-extension request REQ-EXT-CS-301 via BA-UC-008.
Step 2: BADMS validates actor role against HoD role requirement.
Step 3: BADMS rejects the decision attempt with authorization error.
expected_outcome: Action blocked; request remains in Submitted state awaiting respective CS HoD decision.
failure_guarantee: Storage extension approval authority is strictly reserved for HoD; separation of duties maintained.

title: Restoration - Non-Sensitive Standard Path (End-to-End)
description: Verify end-to-end restoration workflow BW-BA-06 / CW-BA-03 Path 1 for Non-Sensitive data where user requests restoration, system places it on Standard Path, and SysAdmin executes technical restoration to Restored state.
pre_conditions: Target dataset is archived with Non-Sensitive classification (Routine or Archival).
execution_steps: Step 1: User submits restoration request for non-sensitive archive ARC-NON-SEN-401 via BA-UC-016.
Step 2: BADMS checks classification (Classification != Sensitive) and transitions state from Not Requested to Restoration Requested / Standard Path.
Step 3: SysAdmin reviews request and initiates technical restoration execution via BA-UC-018.
Step 4: Standard integrity and availability checks are satisfied; BADMS transfers data to recovery storage.
Step 5: System logs restoration timestamp/status and transitions state to Restored.
expected_outcome: Request state transitions: Not Requested -> Restoration Requested / Standard Path -> Restored. Dataset restored without requiring intermediate approval.
failure_guarantee: Restoration execution preserves data consistency; if execution fails, state does not advance to Restored.

title: Restoration - Sensitive Data with SysAdmin Rejection (End-to-End)
description: Verify end-to-end Sensitive restoration path BW-BA-07 / CW-BA-03 Path 2 where user requests restoration of Sensitive data, system routes it to SysAdmin approval, and SysAdmin rejects the request.
pre_conditions: Target dataset is archived with Sensitive classification.

test_inputs.rejection_reason: Restoration request lacks necessary security clearance documentation

execution_steps: Step 1: User requests restoration of Sensitive archive ARC-SEN-501 via BA-UC-016.
Step 2: System detects Classification = Sensitive and transitions state from Not Requested to Sensitive Restoration Pending Approval.
Step 3: SysAdmin evaluates request via BA-UC-017 and selects Outcome = Reject.
Step 4: BADMS records rejection decision and transitions request state to Rejected.
Step 5: System issues decision notification to requester.
expected_outcome: Request state transitions: Not Requested -> Sensitive Restoration Pending Approval -> Rejected. Technical restoration is never initiated.
failure_guarantee: Sensitive data is never restored without explicit SysAdmin approval; state transitions cleanly to Rejected.

title: Restoration - Sensitive Data with SysAdmin Approval and Technical Execution (End-to-End)
description: Verify end-to-end Sensitive restoration path BW-BA-07 / CW-BA-03 Path 3 where user requests Sensitive restoration, SysAdmin approves, and SysAdmin executes technical restoration to Restored state.
pre_conditions: Dataset is archived with Sensitive classification. SysAdmin has operational access to recovery storage.
execution_steps: Step 1: User requests restoration of Sensitive archive ARC-SEN-601 via BA-UC-016.
Step 2: BADMS checks classification and transitions request state to Sensitive Restoration Pending Approval.
Step 3: SysAdmin reviews justification and approves request via BA-UC-017.
Step 4: BADMS transitions request state to Approved for Restoration.
Step 5: SysAdmin initiates technical data restoration via BA-UC-018.
Step 6: Technical execution succeeds: archive decrypted and restored to secure target storage.
Step 7: BADMS logs restoration completion and transitions state to Restored.
expected_outcome: Request transitions: Not Requested -> Sensitive Restoration Pending Approval -> Approved for Restoration -> Restored.
failure_guarantee: Two-stage verification (approval followed by technical execution) is strictly enforced for Sensitive data.

title: Restoration Request - Non-Existent Archive Identifier (Guard Unsatisfied)
description: Verify that submitting a restoration request for an invalid or non-existent archive identifier fails input validation and leaves state in Not Requested.
pre_conditions: User is authenticated.
execution_steps: Step 1: User attempts to initiate restoration for non-existent archive ID ARC-INVALID-99999 via BA-UC-016.
Step 2: BADMS queries archive catalog and finds no matching record.
Step 3: System aborts request creation and returns 'Archive not found' error.
expected_outcome: Validation fails; no restoration request is created; system state remains Not Requested.
failure_guarantee: System rejects invalid archive references; no dangling restoration records created.

title: Sensitive Restoration Approval - Unauthorized Decision Attempt by HoD
primary_obligation: CW-BA-03 Decision Point SysAdmin Authorization Guard
description: Verify that an HoD cannot approve or reject Sensitive data restoration (the PS baseline excludes separate HoD retrieval authorization and requires SysAdmin approval alone).
pre_conditions: Sensitive restoration request is in Sensitive Restoration Pending Approval state.
execution_steps: Step 1: HoD attempts to approve Sensitive restoration request REQ-RST-SEN-701 via BA-UC-017.
Step 2: BADMS checks authorization rules for Sensitive restoration (only SysAdmin authorized; HoD retrieval route not supported).
Step 3: BADMS rejects the HoD approval attempt with authorization failure.
expected_outcome: Action denied; request remains in Sensitive Restoration Pending Approval awaiting authorized SysAdmin decision.
failure_guarantee: SysAdmin alone owns Sensitive restoration approval in this module version; HoD approval bypass is blocked.

title: Restoration Execution - Technical Execution Failure (Execution Guard Unsatisfied)
description: Verify that when technical restoration execution fails due to destination storage unavailability or archive corruption, the request does not transition to Restored and failure is logged.
pre_conditions: Restoration request is in Approved for Restoration state (or Restoration Requested / Standard Path).

test_inputs.simulated_error: Destination repository I/O error; disk space full during extract

execution_steps: Step 1: SysAdmin triggers technical restoration execution via BA-UC-018.
Step 2: System initiates dataset extraction and transfer to recovery storage.
Step 3: Storage write error occurs during data copy.
Step 4: System catches failure, records failure audit entry, and aborts state change.
expected_outcome: Execution fails with technical error; request state remains Approved for Restoration; alert logged to SysAdmin.
failure_guarantee: Incomplete or corrupt restores are never marked as Restored; data integrity guarantee preserved.

title: State Transition Invariance - Out-of-Order Direct Approval on Unsubmitted Archival Request
description: Verify that the system strictly prevents out-of-order state transitions, rejecting HoD approval actions on requests that are in Not Submitted state.
pre_conditions: Request identifier is generated but has not completed valid submission (state is Not Submitted).
execution_steps: Step 1: HoD attempts to invoke BA-UC-003 to approve archival request REQ-ARC-UNSUB-801 directly from Not Submitted state.
Step 2: BADMS workflow engine validates current state transition precondition (requires From State: Submitted).
Step 3: State check fails; BADMS rejects the transition as illegal.
expected_outcome: Illegal transition rejected with InvalidStateTransitionError; state remains Not Submitted.
failure_guarantee: Workflow state machine strictly enforces authoritative transition graph; skipping lifecycle stages is impossible.
